name: radial-gradient
summary: Radial gradient background from a shape and a position.

arguments.name: $shape
accepts: with a size as a string: an extent keyword such as "circle closest-side", one length for a circle, or two lengths or percentages for an ellipse

arguments.name: $position
accepts: a position name such as center or top-left
an extent keyword such as closest-side
at followed by a position, as a string, such as "at 30% 40%" or "at left 10px top 20px", optionally after a size
a word outside these, such as inherit, is refused, because the whole gradient would be dropped

arguments.name: $colors
accepts: one or more colour stops, in the same forms as linear-gradient: a colour with up to two positions, a position between two colours, or var()
a stop the browser drops is refused, because the whole gradient would be dropped
